landing.title: Card auctions in your WhatsApp group
landing.description: Run card auctions in your WhatsApp group and keep sales, buyers and settlements organized in one place.
landing.subtitle: A tool for trading card stores to run auctions and keep their sales organized.

hero.pill: A platform for Pokémon TCG store owners
hero.title: Pokémon card auctions on WhatsApp,
hero.lead: Register your cards, schedule single-card auctions, let the bot look after the group and follow everything on dashboards.

how.title: A Pokémon card auction in four steps
how.lead: The platform organizes the auction and the settlement. Payment and shipping happen directly between the store and the buyer.

0.title: Register the card
0.text: Search the catalog, enter the condition, photos and notes, and choose whether it is your own stock or consigned.

1.title: Schedule the auction
1.text: Set the start, the end, the type (free bidding or poll), the minimum bid and the ceiling.

2.title: The bot looks after the group
2.text: The card is posted on WhatsApp, the bids are recorded and the winner is announced.

3.title: Close the settlement
3.text: The buyer completes their details, agrees on the payment with the store and you confirm the sale.

features.title: Everything for people who sell Pokémon cards
features.lead: Stock, auction schedule, bids, settlements, consignments and team in one place, with no spreadsheets.

0.title: Organized stock
0.text: Register each card with a quick catalog search, real photos, language, condition and notes. Each one gets a short #ID to use in the group conversations.

1.title: Auctions on WhatsApp
1.text: Schedule one auction per card, in free bidding or poll, with a minimum bid and a ceiling. The bot posts the card in the group, records each bid and announces the winner.

2.title: Settlements without spreadsheets
2.text: Whoever wins gets a link to enter their details and see the purchase summary. You add the shipping, send the summary on WhatsApp and confirm the sale once the payment is made.

3.title: Consignment management
3.text: Register other people's cards with your commission. The system calculates the amount sold, the commission kept and how much to pass on to each owner, who follows the card through a link.

4.title: Complete dashboards
4.text: Follow what is happening now on the Home and analyze revenue, profit, average ticket and sales by period on the finance panel, with charts and a list of payouts.

5.title: Group moderation
5.text: Keep a list of blocked numbers and automatically remove whoever stays inactive for too long, with a warning about who is about to leave.

6.title: Team and permissions
6.text: Invite employees by e-mail and choose what each one can do: stock, auctions, settlements or finance. Deleting records is blocked by default.

7.title: Custom messages
7.text: Customize the text posted for each card and the closing message to talk to your group your own way.

who.title: Made for people who sell cards in groups

0.title: TCG store owners
0.text: Who already sell through WhatsApp groups and want to leave manual control behind.

1.title: Collectors who sell
1.text: Who run auctions of rare cards and need to record bids and winners.

2.title: Stores with a team
2.text: Who share tasks between stock, auctions and settlements, with permissions per person.

0.a: Access is by invitation only. You request access, our team creates your store, makes you the owner and sends the invitation by e-mail.

1.a: A panel for Pokémon TCG store owners to run auctions in WhatsApp groups: stock, auction schedule, bids, settlements, consignments and dashboards in one place.

2.q: Do you process payments or ship the cards?
2.a: No. The platform organizes the auction and the settlement. Payment and shipping are agreed directly between the store and the buyer.

3.q: Do I need a dedicated WhatsApp number?
3.a: We recommend a number dedicated to the store. You connect it by reading a QR code and choose which group the bot will watch.

4.a: You register the card in the owner's name and set the store's commission. When it is sold, the finance panel shows how much to pass on, and the owner follows the card through a link.

5.a: Only if you allow it. Deleting items and records is blocked by default, and each permission is chosen per employee.

6.q: Which cards and languages can I register?
6.a: Any card in the catalog, in Portuguese, English, Japanese and other languages, with conditions from M to DMG.

cta.title: Ready to organize your auctions?
cta.text: Tell us about your store. Our team creates your access and sends the invitation by e-mail.

footer.note: A platform for Pokémon TCG auctions on WhatsApp for store owners and collectors. Pokémon and the card names belong to their respective owners.

showcase.title: Your live auctions, in plain sight
showcase.text: Each running auction can appear on a public page with the card photo, the condition, the language, the last bid and the time left. Whoever is interested goes straight to the group of the store.

points.0: More visibility for your cards, even for people who are not in the group yet.
points.2: You choose whether your store appears on the showcase.

dashboards.finance: The finance panel gathers gross revenue, net profit, average ticket, charts by period, the split of sales by price, language and condition, and the list of consignment payouts.
dashboards.access: Finance is only for the owner or whoever gets that permission.

permissions.title: Global permissions
permissions.hint: Without this permission, the user only joins stores they were invited to or that the administrator created for them.
permissions.adminFixed: The permissions of a platform administrator cannot be changed here.

stores.title: Linked stores
stores.empty: This user is not in any store yet.
stores.note: Read only · the administrator does not change the data of the stores

access.title: Access
access.hint: Suspending blocks the login in every store, without deleting any data.

user.noInvitation: We found no pending invitation for this e-mail.

suspend.title: Suspend access
suspend.text: {who} will not be able to sign in to any store. Nothing is deleted, and you can let them back in later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate access
reactivate.text: {who} will be able to sign in again.

stores.title: Stores
stores.caption: Stores
stores.note: The administrator creates the store and sets the owner · WhatsApp, stock and team are managed by the owner

error.title: We could not load the stores
error.text: Check the connection and try again.

empty.title: No stores yet
empty.text: Create the first store and set its owner.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.hint: Search by name or e-mail. Only active accounts.
transfer.count: No accounts found | 1 account found | {count} accounts found
transfer.needsUser: Pick the account of the new owner.
transfer.text: The current owner becomes an employee of the store. No data of the store is changed.

new.title: Create store
new.name: Store name
new.planHint: The code of the plan, e.g. STANDARD. Empty uses the default.
new.fromRequest: Creating the store of the request from {name}.

owner.title: Owner
owner.hint: A new e-mail gets an invitation by e-mail. The owner signs in with a code, connects the WhatsApp and invites their own team.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the name of the store.
errors.planInvalid: The code of a plan has capital letters, digits and _ (2 to 20 characters).
errors.memberLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.cardLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000000, or leave it empty.
errors.ownerUser: Pick the account of the owner.

invitations.title: Invitations and requests
invitations.error: We could not load the list

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation
revoke.text: The link sent to {email} stops working right away.

requests.note: Refusing sends nothing to the person. To approve, create the store from the request.

refuse.title: Refuse the request
refuse.text: The request of {name} is refused. Nothing is sent to the person.

settlementPage.title: Your settlement
settlementPage.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

invalid.title: This link is not available
invalid.text: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask the store for a new one.

failed.title: We could not open your settlement
failed.text: Check the connection and try again.

settlementPage.heading: Your settlement, {name}
settlementPage.intro: You won no cards at the auctions of {store}. | You won 1 card at the auctions of {store}. data.title: Your data
data.use: used by the store for the shipping
data.consent: I agree that the store keeps my CPF and address to prepare the shipping
data.consentNote: Your CPF is stored encrypted and the store only sees it masked. You can ask the store to remove your data.

pay.title: Payment
pay.text: The payment is made directly to the store. The platform does not process the payment or the shipping.
pay.noPix: The store has not shared a PIX key yet. Ask the store how to pay.
pay.claim: I already paid, notify the store
pay.claimedAt: You told the store you paid on {when}.
pay.note: This only warns the store: it is the store that confirms the payment.

errors.state: Enter the two letters of the state.
errors.consent: You need to agree to continue.

consignorPage.title: Follow your card

invalid.title: This link is not available
invalid.text: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask the store for a new one.

gate.title: Follow your card
gate.text: Enter your access key: the first 4 numbers of your CPF.
gate.label: Access key
gate.refused: This link is not available or the key is wrong. Ask the store for help.
gate.blocked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
gate.failed: We could not open the page. Try again in a moment.
gate.note: Wrong key? Talk to the store.

consignorPage.heading: {name}, your cards at {store}
consignorPage.intro: The amounts below are an estimate until the auction ends and the store confirms the sale.
consignorPage.empty: You have no cards consigned to this store right now.

estimate.title: Payout estimate
estimate.note: The final value is set when the auction ends and the store confirms the sale.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.error: We could not load the settlements
settlements.claimed: The buyer said they paid on {when}
settlements.awaitingEmpty: No buyer is waiting for a settlement
settlements.awaitingNote: Buyers who won auctions and have no settlement yet. The total is the sum of the cards: the platform does not handle shipping or payment.

link.aria: Make the link of the settlement of {name}
link.title: Link for the buyer
link.text: Send this link to {name}. They check the summary, fill in their CPF and address, and tell you when they paid.

link.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
link.message: Hi, {name}! Here is the summary of your purchase and where to leave your data: {link}
